summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2115966161405812865))** summarizes **CaMeL**, *Defeating Prompt Injections by Design* ([arXiv 2503.18813](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.18813)): a privileged LLM plans without seeing untrusted data, a quarantined LLM parses data without tools, values carry provenance capabilities and Python policies check each call, giving 77% AgentDojo utility (from 84%) with zero successful attacks at ~2.8× tokens; side channels remain open.
